data.title: Income Tax Assessment 2025 – Finanzamt Beispiel-Merzig
data.summary: The Finanzamt Beispiel-Merzig issued the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025, setting the income tax at €3,014.00 and resulting in a refund (Guthaben) of €654.00 to be transferred to the recipient's account.
data.explanation: This is your official income tax assessment for 2025. The tax office calculated your tax based on your employment income, work-related expenses (Werbungskosten) and special expenses (Sonderausgaben), resulting in a refund of €654.00 that will be transferred automatically — no action is needed for that. If you believe the assessment is incorrect, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or electronically with the tax office; the app shows until when you can decide and act. If you do nothing, the assessment becomes final and binding.
data.tax_note: This document is itself the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025 and should be kept with your tax records.

remedy.form_text: Richten Sie den Einspruch schriftlich oder elektronisch an das Finanzamt Beispiel-Merzig; Sie können ihn dort auch zu Protokoll geben.
remedy.quote: Wer diesen Bescheid für fehlerhaft hält, kann dagegen innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch erheben.

items.title: Decide whether to file an objection (Einspruch)
